therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Intraventricular methotrexate with topotecan and cyclophosphamide
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: DNA synthesis and cell cycle progression
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase blocking DNA synthesis, topotecan inhibits topoisomerase I, cyclophosphamide causes DNA cross-linking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation and survival in CNS malignancies
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Children with recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumors

results.dose_information: Intrathecal methotrexate via Ommaya reservoir with concomitant systemic topotecan and cyclophosphamide

context.investigator_commentary: Lack of additional funding; patients (3) no longer receiving intervention.
